name: filter.feedId
title: Field: filter.feedId
description: Meaning of the buyer query filter.feedId field.
text:
# filter.feedId

TL;DR:
- filter.feedId limits results to one feed-driven browsing context.

What it means:
- feedId scopes the listing query to one feed surface or feed-derived context.
- It is useful when the browsing workflow already started from a known feed.

Agent hint:
- Use this only when the surrounding workflow is explicitly feed-based. Otherwise prefer normal category or search filters.
